name: ImgEdit-Bench
intro: ImgEdit-Bench 是 ImgEdit 论文提出的统一图像编辑评测集，共 811 个案例，分别检验基础编辑、理解-定位-编辑（UGE）和三轮连续编辑能力，并区分单轮自动评分与多轮人工评分。
org: Peking University Shenzhen Graduate School, Peng Cheng Laboratory, Rabbitpre AI
build_method: 人工收集与筛选图像，GPT-4o 生成基础指令后人工过滤，专家设计 UGE 与多轮任务
metric: GPT-4o 1–5分，多轮人工成功率，FakeShield伪影定位召回率
task_type: 图像编辑, 指令遵循, 多轮编辑
eval_feature: 基础编辑, 理解-定位-编辑, 内容记忆, 内容理解, 版本回退
task_type_en: Image editing, instruction following, multi-turn editing
build_method_en: Manual image collection and screening; GPT-4o instruction generation with manual filtering; expert-authored UGE and multi-turn tasks
eval_feature_en: Basic editing, understanding-grounding-editing, content memory, content understanding, version backtracking
intro_en: ImgEdit-Bench is the unified image-editing benchmark introduced by the ImgEdit paper. Its 811 cases cover basic editing, understanding-grounding-editing (UGE), and three-turn sequential editing, with separate single-turn automatic and multi-turn human scoring paths.
metric_en: GPT-4o 1–5 ratings, human multi-turn success, FakeShield artifact-localization recall

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.20275v1, official Git revision b79848168744c8db8389086d01fe3def1758aa45, and Hugging Face dataset revision f8de753484a2b6bd37f135fd20d308b66b09a523. The paper snapshot contains 811 cases: a 734-case Basic suite spanning nine common edit tasks, a manually curated 47-case UGE suite, and a 30-case multi-turn suite with three turns each. Basic images are manually collected from the Internet across six super-categories and ten concepts each; GPT-4o proposes instructions that are manually filtered. UGE covers occlusion, repeated instances, camouflage, uncommon subjects, spatial reasoning, multi-object, compound, fine-grained, and large-scale edits. Multi-turn cases test content memory, content understanding, and version backtracking. Single-turn experiments preserve native resolution, repeat each setting three times, and use GPT-4o 1–5 rubrics for instruction adherence, editing quality, and detail preservation; quality and preservation cannot exceed adherence. Multi-turn scoring is human yes/no; FakeShield recall is auxiliary. The optional ImgEdit-Judge uses 200k ratings, with a 60-image study reporting almost 70% agreement within one point. Version boundary: the paper has 734 Basic cases, while the current pinned Git release has 737 Basic JSON records and UGE has 47; the multi-turn archive is distributed at the pinned Hugging Face revision.
